lines.text: Sri Ch. Naveen Kumar, Senior Assistant, Regional Office, Eluru has requested a transfer to Regional Office, Vijayawada on spouse grounds.
In File USD01-12/31/2022-ESTT.I, Note #5, 20-06-2022, it was approved and orders were issued.
In File USD01-12/77/2023-ESTT.I, Note #5, 02-09-2023, it was not agreed at present, as the ban on transfers is in force, and the individual was informed accordingly.
In File USD01-12/44/2025-ESTT.I, Note #5, 27-05-2025, it was approved.
The ban on transfers is relaxed for the period from 15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025.
Transfers in any category shall not exceed 15% of the cadre strength of that category, and no relaxation of this ceiling shall be made without the prior concurrence of the Finance Department.
Spouse cases, where both spouses are State Government employees, shall be given preference subject to availability of vacancy.
The competent authority for transfers of Section Officers and below in the Secretariat Departments shall be the Secretary to Government of the Department concerned.
After 31-05-2025 the ban on transfers shall come into force again, and no transfer shall thereafter be ordered without the prior approval of the Government in the Finance Department.
Guidelines for general transfers of employees for the year 2025 were issued under AP-FIN01-GOMS-31-2025, dated 12-05-2025.
Clarifications on the computation of station period for general transfers 2025 were issued under AP-FIN01-MEMO-FIN01HRPLG0TRF-3-2025-2-D20250521, dated 21-05-2025.

Instructions regarding transfers of employees facing vigilance enquiries or disciplinary proceedings require prior clearance of the Vigilance section under AP-GAD01-CIRMEMO-GAD01SERA0-3-2023-D20230814, dated 14-08-2023.

There is a potential conflict as the proposal relies on AP-FIN01-GOMS-88-2022 (03-06-2022), which appears superseded by AP-FIN01-GOMS-31-2025 (12-05-2025); review recommended to verify applicability before approval.
There is a potential conflict as the proposal relies on AP-FIN01-GOMS-104-2026, which was not found among indexed records; review recommended to verify the authority.
There is a potential conflict as the proposal is dated 22-09-2026, which is outside the period from 15-05-2025 to 31-05-2025; review recommended to confirm the transfer can be made at this time.

There is a potential conflict as the proposal seeks approval by Deputy Secretary, who can only recommend, whereas the competent authority is Secretary to Government; review recommended to submit to Secretary to Government.
It is submitted that the request of Sri Ch. Naveen Kumar, Senior Assistant, Regional Office, Eluru for transfer to Regional Office, Vijayawada on spouse grounds may kindly be considered.
